use_when: to show where a page sits in a hierarchy, such as Dashboard / Inventory.
on pages two or more levels deep.
Make every level a link, except the current page.
Place it at the top of the page, above the page title.

dont_use_when.when: on a top-level page, such as the dashboard home.
to show steps in a flow.
Do not make the current page a link.
Do not show more than 4 levels. Shorten the middle levels instead.

best_practice: Use the same page names as the navigation and page titles.
Keep labels short, one or two words.
Keep the breadcrumb on one line.

variant_intent.levels=2: Shows two levels, the last being the current page (Figma default: Dashboard / Inventory).
variant_intent.levels=3: Shows three levels, the last being the current page.
variant_intent.levels=4: Shows four levels, the last being the current page. Figma: no more than 4 levels.

placement: Place it at the top of the page, above the page title.

a11y.fact: Wrapped in a <nav> landmark labelled "Breadcrumb" by default.
The current page is marked aria-current="page".
The separators are hidden from screen readers.
Every level except the last renders as an <a> link.
Links show a focus ring on keyboard focus.
